purpose: A deterministic near-window active-context stress workload for Phase 13; configured capacity alone does not satisfy this test.

workload.system: You are completing a controlled local context-sensitivity performance run. Read all supplied synthetic records, then follow the final instruction. Do not use headings or bullet lists.
